grid.coordinate_semantics: listed LON/LAT values are pixel centers

population_source.license: ORNL LandScan End User License Agreement; local licensed input only
population_source.basis: Inference from PAGER documentation naming LandScan and release chronology; the PAGER run log does not expose the annual release.

fixture.legal_note: Derived hazard intensity values from a public USGS artifact; no LandScan population values are included.

method.conversion: Snap the four-decimal center coordinates to one arc-minute centers, use half-cell corner offsets, and preserve north-to-south rows.
method.assignment: Use population_exposure raster sum resampling, then classify each hazard cell with PAGER half-open MMI intervals.
method.relationship: A one-arc-minute hazard cell receives the coverage-weighted sum of its 30-arc-second population cells. This matches per-population-cell classification only where the hazard category is constant across that cell group; the live comparison measures the residual.
method.live_tolerance_basis: Integer LandScan cell counts summed as float64; tolerance is one half person for numerical rounding only, not a broad source-difference allowance.
